name: language_identification
description: Identify six European languages from short phrases; matched controls copy explicitly supplied language names.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
data={'French':['bonjour tout le monde','je vous remercie beaucoup','je ne comprends pas','nous sommes ici','comment allez-vous','je voudrais un livre','il fait beau ce matin','je suis avec vous'],'German':['guten Morgen zusammen','vielen Dank','ich verstehe das nicht','wo ist der Bahnhof','wie geht es Ihnen','ich brauche ein Buch','das Wetter ist heute gut','ich freue mich sehr'],'Spanish':['hola a todos','muchas gracias por su ayuda','no entiendo nada','estamos en casa','estoy muy bien','quiero un libro','hace buen tiempo hoy','estoy muy contento'],'Italian':['buongiorno a tutti','grazie mille per il tuo aiuto','non capisco niente','dove si trova la stazione','come stai oggi','vorrei un libro','mi piace molto','sono molto felice'],'Portuguese':['bom dia a todos','muito obrigado pela ajuda','estamos aqui juntos','onde fica o hotel','eu gosto muito disso','eu gostaria de um livro','hoje estamos em casa','estou muito feliz'],'English':['good morning everyone','thank you very much for your help','I do not understand','where is the train station','how are you today','I would like a book','the weather is nice today','I am very happy']}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 lang=list(data)[i%6]; phrase=data[lang][(i//6)%8]; ref=random.choice(list(data)); text=f'Text: "{phrase}". Reference language: {ref}. '
 items.append({'prompt':text+'Identify the language of the text. Answer in English:','answer':' '+lang})
 control.append({'prompt':text+'Copy the reference language. Answer in English:','answer':' '+ref})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
